user.title: Connect TinyPrint X6h
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address. No mobile app or pairing is required. Power on the printer before printing. For Cyrillic, provide a local Unicode TTF/OTF font path.

bluetooth_confirm.title: TinyPrint X6h discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? This does not print anything.

error.invalid_address: Enter an address in the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported X6h printer
abort.invalid_address: Invalid Bluetooth MAC address in configuration.
abort.invalid_adapter: Enter a valid nonzero local Bluetooth adapter MAC.
abort.invalid_proxy: Enter the Bluetooth MAC of the ESPHome proxy, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

init.title: Printing options
init.description: Bridge settings are only available to administrators. Switching back to native Bluetooth removes the stored bridge address and token.

data_description.transport: Native uses HA Bluetooth/proxies. Direct LE uses this Linux host without a bridge or key. Bridge is an optional separate server.
data_description.bridge_url: Address of the bridge, for example http://100.64.0.5:8765. Use the Tailscale or LAN address the bridge listens on.
data_description.bridge_token: Leave blank to keep the saved token. On the bridge host, read the file named by TINYPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN_FILE in bridge.env (see docs/bridge.md)
data_description.adapter_mac: Direct LE only: adapter address from bluetoothctl list, not the printer address. No bridge or token.
data_description.proxy_source: ESPHome proxy only: Bluetooth MAC of the proxy (the source shown in the Bluetooth integration diagnostics). Printing never falls back to another adapter.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host and optional port, without a path, login or query
error.invalid_token: The token must be at least 32 printable characters without spaces
error.cannot_connect: The bridge did not answer. Check that it is running and reachable from Home Assistant
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the access token
error.invalid_adapter: Enter a valid nonzero local Bluetooth adapter MAC.
error.invalid_proxy: Enter the Bluetooth MAC of the ESPHome proxy, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

print_text.name: Print text
print_text.description: Print wrapped text as a bitmap. The response confirms transport only, not physical paper output.

text.name: Text
text.description: Plain text, up to 3000 characters; limited to 2048 rendered rows.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Required when multiple TinyPrint printers are configured.

print_qr.name: Print QR code
print_qr.description: Print a QR code without interpolation, including its quiet zone.

text.name: QR data
text.description: Up to 500 characters; dense codes that cannot fit are rejected.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Required when multiple TinyPrint printers are configured.

print_image.name: Print image
print_image.description: Print a local image from an allowed Home Assistant path. Remote URLs are not accepted.

path.name: Image path
path.description: Local image, at most 4 MiB and 4 million source pixels, 2048 output rows.

device_id.description: Required when multiple TinyPrint printers are configured.
